title: service-settings: a map specifier admits any key when its option source answers an empty list; two missing shape pins; a stale json comment (#31386 review nits)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② the three non-blocking nits from the Fable contract review of PR #31386 (#30208 row 5 phase 1, review 6717755004), recorded on #30208 (6717781477) as "owed as a small follow-up after #31386 merges". #31386 merged at 2026-11-08T06:50Z. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/services/service-settings` (`SettingsService.mapShapeVerdict`, `map-shape.ts`) and `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `mapShapeVerdict empty`, `map specifier fail closed` → only #30208 / PR #31386.
reach: (1) every host whose lifecycle-class option source answers an empty list, where a map key admits any entry key instead of refusing it.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p3. The server seat graded it itself (Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 「定级你可以自己决定」). Nothing ships wrong today: with no lifecycle objects, no map row has a key that could be right.

## 维护者速读

#31386 新加的 `map` 设置类型有三处小尾巴，都是复审时记下的非阻塞项：选项来源答了空列表时，键的校验会放行任何键（应当拒绝）；少两个测试；一处注释还把这些键叫 json。

## Items

1. `mapShapeVerdict` admits every key when a reachable option source answers an empty list. It should fail closed whenever the source answered at all, and keep the `allowed.length > 0` gate only for the declared-table fallback. Pin: a registry with no lifecycle objects gives `invalid_option`.
2. Missing pins: an array value (`not_a_map` gives `invalid_type`), and a scalar entry in a several-column map (`not_an_entry` gives `invalid_shape`).
3. The comment at `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts` (~l.1161) still calls these keys `json` specifiers.

Item 1 refuses a save that was accepted before, so it is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, and the changeset says so.

Refs #30208, PR #31386
